description: Zero-dependency Python library for safe dot-notation access to nested dicts, lists and tuples: get_at, set_at, delete_at and exists_at, plus get_depth, count_leaves and get_all_paths for introspection.
rules: Import from nestedutils: get_at, set_at, delete_at, exists_at, get_depth, count_leaves, get_all_paths, PathError.
In v2, get_at raises PathError for a missing path unless you pass default=...; see migration-v1-to-v2.md when upgrading from 1.x.
set_at needs create=True to build missing containers, and it never creates sparse lists (an index may be at most len(list)).
delete_at refuses to delete list items unless allow_list_mutation=True.
